p, k = map(int, input().split())
mark = [0] * p
result = 1
start_point = 0 if k == 1 else 1
MOD = 1000000007

for i in range(start_point, p):
    if mark[i] == 0:
        current = i
        while mark[current] == 0:
            mark[current] = 1
            current = (k * current) % p
        result = (result * p) % MOD

print(result)
